q: What is the escape of water excess under the Harbourline commercial property policy?

q: How many days before a building counts as unoccupied under Harbourline?

q: How quickly must a claim be notified to Harbourline, and what if it is late?

q: What fire suppression condition applies to restaurants under the Harbourline wording?
evidence: serviced at least every six months
answer: Where there is deep-fat frying, an automatic fire suppression system must be fitted and serviced at least every six months; it is a condition precedent for fire claims.

q: Why did Harbourline refuse to quote Bramble Kitchen?
answer: The fryer suppression system was last serviced in March 2026, more than six months ago; they will quote at 0.28% if a recent service certificate is provided.

q: Do we place restaurants with deep-fat frying?

q: Which trades do we decline?
evidence: waste and recycling, scrap metal, fireworks
answer: Waste and recycling, scrap metal, fireworks, nightclubs, demolition, and any business with a prior arson claim in the last five years. Deep-fat frying risks without a serviced fire suppression system must also be declined.
